Hermes Agent, ZeroClaw, NanoClaw, IronClaw, HiClaw, and AstrBot all remained repo-active in the latest snapshot, but there was no taxonomy-changing entrant or positioning shift in the monitored set.
whyItMatters: The daily signal is still execution velocity, not a new category shape: OpenClaw is shipping like the pace-setter, PicoClaw keeps reinforcing the low-cost edge wedge, and Poco continues to validate the safer polished-product lane.
